paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi, hastening toward Nagakute, was astonished. No close inspection was needed: one glance at the great antlered helmet in the vanguard showed that the newcomer could be none other than Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi, hastening toward Nagakute, was astonished. No close inspection was needed: one glance at the great antlered helmet in the vanguard showed that the newcomer could be none other than Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu.

paragraphs.source_en: The vicious abuse, coupled with the enemy’s repeated gunfire, was more than Hideyoshi’s men could endure. “My lord!” The hot-blooded guards could contain themselves no longer. “That filthy fly dares show such insolence to our lord. Shall we not crush it underfoot?”

units.source_en: The vicious abuse, coupled with the enemy’s repeated gunfire, was more than Hideyoshi’s men could endure.

paragraphs.source_en: Even the most patient man has his limits, and Hideyoshi was no exception. At last, Hideyoshi’s exasperated troops opened fire on Tadakatsu. It was an irrational act, but hardly a rare one on the battlefield. In an encounter, most men are easily angered, and anger leads to one of two outcomes: overwhelming victory or crushing defeat.

units.source_en: Even the most patient man has his limits, and Hideyoshi was no exception.
units.source_zh: 再能忍耐的人也有限度，秀吉当然也不例外。

units.source_en: At last, Hideyoshi’s exasperated troops opened fire on Tadakatsu.

units.source_en: It was an irrational act, but hardly a rare one on the battlefield.

units.source_en: In an encounter, most men are easily angered, and anger leads to one of two outcomes: overwhelming victory or crushing defeat.
units.source_zh: 遭遇战的时候，大多数人都极易发怒，而发怒即导致两种结果：要么大胜，要么大败。

paragraphs.source_zh: 再能忍耐的人也有限度，秀吉当然也不例外。忍无可忍的秀吉人马终于向忠胜开火了。这是失去理智的行为，在战场上并不少见。遭遇战的时候，大多数人都极易发怒，而发怒即导致两种结果：要么大胜，要么大败。

paragraphs.source_en: Reason helps one discover the enemy’s weaknesses, but it also deepens the sense of fear. Therefore, the proper regulation of soldiers’ emotions and state of mind is one of the great principles of warfare. Hideyoshi did not firmly forbid his men from exchanging fire with Honda, but neither did he allow them to halt their advance.

units.source_en: Reason helps one discover the enemy’s weaknesses, but it also deepens the sense of fear.
units.source_zh: 理智可助于发现对方的破绽，也会加重恐惧之感。

units.source_en: Therefore, the proper regulation of soldiers’ emotions and state of mind is one of the great principles of warfare.
units.source_zh: 故，适度地调整士兵的情绪与心态，乃是用兵之大道。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi did not firmly forbid his men from exchanging fire with Honda, but neither did he allow them to halt their advance.

paragraphs.source_zh: 理智可助于发现对方的破绽，也会加重恐惧之感。故，适度地调整士兵的情绪与心态，乃是用兵之大道。秀吉并没有坚决阻止手下和本多交火，但也没让他们停止前进。

paragraphs.source_en: It was past noon. Ki-no-kami Motosuke had already been beheaded by Andō Hikobē Naotsugu, while the surviving troops, guarding the barely living Terumasa, fled in the direction of Shidami, Mizuno, Shinoki, and Kashiwai.

units.source_en: It was past noon. Ki-no-kami Motosuke had already been beheaded by Andō Hikobē Naotsugu, while the surviving troops, guarding the barely living Terumasa, fled in the direction of Shidami, Mizuno, Shinoki, and Kashiwai.
units.source_zh: 已过了午时，纪伊守元助已被安藤彦兵卫直次斩首，残部则护卫着苟延残喘的辉政向士段味、水野、筱木、柏井方向溃退。

paragraphs.source_zh: 已过了午时，纪伊守元助已被安藤彦兵卫直次斩首，残部则护卫着苟延残喘的辉政向士段味、水野、筱木、柏井方向溃退。

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu gradually regained his reason. Suddenly he understood why Hideyoshi had ignored him and pressed relentlessly onward: Hideyoshi wanted nothing but a decisive battle with his lord! Once that thought struck him, Tadakatsu dared not linger on the road any longer. He wanted to rejoin his lord’s main force as quickly as possible so that together they could meet Hideyoshi’s great army.

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu gradually regained his reason.
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠胜逐渐恢复了理智。

units.source_en: Suddenly he understood why Hideyoshi had ignored him and pressed relentlessly onward: Hideyoshi wanted nothing but a decisive battle with his lord!
units.source_zh: 他突然悟到秀吉置之不理，一味急进的用意了：秀吉原来只是想跟主公决战！

units.source_en: Once that thought struck him, Tadakatsu dared not linger on the road any longer.

ja.t: やしてはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 这样一想，忠胜再也不敢在路上耽搁。

units.source_en: He wanted to rejoin his lord’s main force as quickly as possible so that together they could meet Hideyoshi’s great army.
units.source_zh: 他想尽快和主公的主力会合，共迎秀吉大军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠胜逐渐恢复了理智。他突然悟到秀吉置之不理，一味急进的用意了：秀吉原来只是想跟主公决战！这样一想，忠胜再也不敢在路上耽搁。他想尽快和主公的主力会合，共迎秀吉大军。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi continued to ignore him and led his great host swiftly onward. They crossed the Yada River and passed Kusakakē, until at last Honda’s forces vanished from sight.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi continued to ignore him and led his great host swiftly onward.
units.source_zh: 秀吉依然对其不理不睬，继续率领大部队急进。

units.source_en: They crossed the Yada River and passed Kusakakē, until at last Honda’s forces vanished from sight.
units.source_zh: 他们渡过矢田川，越过草挂，终于看不见本多的人马了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉依然对其不理不睬，继续率领大部队急进。他们渡过矢田川，越过草挂，终于看不见本多的人马了。

paragraphs.source_en: Where, then, had Honda Tadakatsu, who left Hideyoshi beset by doubts, concealed himself? In fact, Tadakatsu had spurred his horse onward and already reached Obata Castle, where Ieyasu had camped the previous night. Tadakatsu himself could never have imagined that the countless childish provocations he had inflicted upon Hideyoshi in a fit of anger would have an immeasurable effect on Ieyasu’s freedom to advance or withdraw.

units.source_en: Where, then, had Honda Tadakatsu, who left Hideyoshi beset by doubts, concealed himself?
units.source_zh: 那么，让秀吉陷入重重疑惑的本多忠胜又藏到哪里了呢？

units.source_en: In fact, Tadakatsu had spurred his horse onward and already reached Obata Castle, where Ieyasu had camped the previous night.
units.source_zh: 原来，忠胜快马加鞭，早已赶到家康前一夜驻营的小幡城去了。

units.source_en: Tadakatsu himself could never have imagined that the countless childish provocations he had inflicted upon Hideyoshi in a fit of anger would have an immeasurable effect on Ieyasu’s freedom to advance or withdraw.
units.source_zh: 忠胜也万万没有想到，一时气愤而恶童般对秀吉进行的百般骚扰，竟对家康的进退产生了不可估量的作用。

paragraphs.source_zh: 那么，让秀吉陷入重重疑惑的本多忠胜又藏到哪里了呢？原来，忠胜快马加鞭，早已赶到家康前一夜驻营的小幡城去了。忠胜也万万没有想到，一时气愤而恶童般对秀吉进行的百般骚扰，竟对家康的进退产生了不可估量的作用。
